newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Metra 1996 profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Metra 1996 profit seen up.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 897 million markka median forecast for diversified engineering group Metra Oy Ab's full-year profit before extraordinary items and tax.
Metra's results are due on February 19 at 0830/0630 GMT.
In 1995, Metra had a 795 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.
For the company's full-year 1997 profit, 10 of the 16 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 833 million markka (mean 879 million) in a 683 million to 1.14 billion markka range. @

Contributors to the survey were AG Private Bankers, Alfred Berg, Aros Securities, Carnegie, Den Danske Bank, Enskilda Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, FSB Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Kleinwort Benson, Merita Securities, Opstock and Postipankki.
